notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible: two separately manipulated upper-cabinet doors and two drawers. Open is treated as the on state and closed as the off state.
scene_description: A person surveys a compact kitchen, then opens and later closes the two doors of the cabinet above the refrigerator and the top drawers on each side of the stove.
